description: This Kotlin test source file defines unit tests for the TopicViewModel in the Now in Android project. It tests various UI state transitions, data loading, and follow/unfollow functionality related to topics and news resources within the feature/topic/impl module.

classes.name: TopicViewModelTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of TopicViewModel in different UI states and interactions within the feature topic implementation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the TopicViewModel instance before each test.

methods.name: topicId_matchesTopicIdFromSavedStateHandle
methods.description: Verifies that the ViewModel's topicId matches the expected test input.

methods.name: uiStateTopic_whenSuccess_matchesTopicFromRepository
methods.description: Tests that the UI state reflects the correct topic after successful data retrieval.

methods.name: uiStateNews_whenInitialized_thenShowLoading
methods.description: Checks that the news UI state initially shows a loading state.

methods.name: uiStateTopic_whenInitialized_thenShowLoading
methods.description: Checks that the topic UI state initially shows a loading state.

methods.name: uiStateTopic_whenFollowedIdsSuccessAndTopicLoading_thenShowLoading
methods.description: Verifies loading state when followed IDs are successfully fetched, but topic data is still loading.

methods.name: uiStateTopic_whenFollowedIdsSuccessAndTopicSuccess_thenTopicSuccessAndNewsLoading
methods.description: Ensures that both topic success and news loading states are achieved after data fetch.

methods.name: uiStateTopic_whenFollowedIdsSuccessAndTopicSuccessAndNewsIsSuccess_thenAllSuccess
methods.description: Verifies that all UI states switch to success after data has been loaded successfully.

methods.name: uiStateTopic_whenFollowingTopic_thenShowUpdatedTopic
methods.description: Tests the UI reflects topic follow toggling properly.
